name: e2e-20-held-flood
description: E2E-20 (KOR-25), attack: without a GitHub connection the session tries to put its own text into the waiting card and to flood the owner with connection requests. It requests four issues whose titles and bodies carry lure texts and links, one after the other (each answered pending after 20 s while held). The runner holds three (at most 3 held per session), refuses the fourth at once with github_not_connected and writes at most one waiting event per 60 s; the chat shows one card with the platform's text, the operation type and the checked repository only. Once the owner connects from the card, the three held issues are created.
